core_platform.description: GitLab provides an integrated software development and DevSecOps platform covering source code management, planning, code review, CI/CD, security, compliance, and deployment.

ai_product.name: GitLab Duo
ai_capabilities: AI-assisted code explanation, generation, fixing, and refactoring

agent_types.foundational_agents: Pre-built production-ready agents created by GitLab for specific development workflows.
agent_types.custom_agents: User-configured agents whose behavior is defined through system prompts and selected tools.
agent_types.external_agents: External AI agents such as Claude and Codex that can operate inside GitLab and can be triggered from issues or merge requests.

software_development_flow.purpose: Performs complex software-development tasks from the IDE using a plan-and-execute workflow.
behavior: Creates a plan from the developer's request
Allows the developer to accept, modify, or reject proposed changes

agentic_code_review.description: Automatically reviews merge requests using repository, pipeline, and security-policy context.
agentic_code_review.pricing: 0.25 USD per review / 4 reviews per GitLab Credit

agentic_security_remediation.name: Agentic SAST Vulnerability Resolution
agentic_security_remediation.tier: GitLab Ultimate with GitLab Duo Agent Platform
behavior: Generates a code fix addressing the vulnerability

ci_agent.name: CI Expert Agent
behavior: Targets a running pipeline without requiring manual YAML creation

important_pricing_structure: GitLab Duo capabilities can be provided through subscription tiers/add-ons
GitLab Credits are used as a usage-based AI currency
Premium and Ultimate customers receive included GitLab Credits
Additional GitLab Credits can be purchased
Some agentic capabilities have usage-based costs
GitLab Duo Pro and Enterprise use a seat-based add-on model
GitLab Duo Agent Platform Self-Hosted can use an enterprise license agreement with a flat customer fee for offline-license customers

known_current_pricing.premium_included_credits: 12 GitLab Credits per user per month

ai_pricing_model.free_tier: GitLab.com Free organizations can use GitLab Duo Agent Platform by purchasing a monthly GitLab Credits commitment.

models_and_model_providers.model_strategy: GitLab Duo uses different LLMs for different AI tasks rather than relying on a single model provider.

data_and_privacy.model_training: GitLab states that it does not train generative AI models and its AI model subprocessors are restricted from using customer inputs and outputs to train their models.
data_and_privacy.data_retention: GitLab documents different retention behavior depending on the model provider and feature, including zero-data-retention arrangements with some providers.
data_and_privacy.security: GitLab Duo includes secret detection and redaction in specified AI workflows before sensitive information is sent to LLMs.

changes: Broader access to GitLab Duo Agent Platform
Free-tier access through GitLab Credits commitment
Agentic Code Review pricing introduced at 0.25 USD per review
Agentic false-positive detection for security scanning became generally available
Agentic SAST Vulnerability Resolution became generally available
CI Expert Agent introduced in beta
Data Analyst Agent became generally available
Subscription-level GitLab Credit spending caps introduced
Per-user GitLab Credit spending caps introduced

competitive_baseline.ai_capability: GitLab combines AI coding assistance with agentic capabilities that operate across development, code review, security, CI, and software-lifecycle analytics.
competitive_baseline.autonomy: GitLab's agentic capabilities can plan and execute multi-step development tasks, generate repository changes, create fixes, and open merge requests, while retaining developer review and approval points for relevant workflows.
competitive_baseline.context: GitLab's agents can use context already present in the GitLab platform, including repositories, project structure, code, issues, merge requests, pipelines, and security findings.
competitive_baseline.pricing: GitLab combines subscription-based tiers/add-ons with usage-based GitLab Credits for AI capabilities.
competitive_baseline.availability: AI capabilities vary by GitLab tier, deployment model, feature status, and whether the capability is GA, beta, or otherwise restricted.
competitive_baseline.ecosystem: GitLab supports AI inside its own development platform and also supports external agents such as Claude Code and Codex.

research_goal:
Compare GitLab's competitors in AI-assisted and agentic software development
to understand how their products support developers across the software
development lifecycle, including the capabilities they provide, the degree
of autonomy they enable, how they integrate with existing development
workflows, their availability and pricing, and how these offerings have
evolved recently.
